purpose: Add privacy-bounded public product analytics through the existing first-party web boundary without session replay, PII collection, protected-route telemetry, registration changes or production topology changes.
effectiveAfter: This governance manifest is merged to main. The implementation branch must then synchronize to that accepted main and stay within the finite path set below.
requiredInvariants: Session replay, autocapture and browser-side PostHog SDK loading remain disabled.
Analytics remains fail-closed outside the existing public allowlist plus exact /platform-v7; no descendant /platform-v7/* route becomes eligible by prefix.
The browser sends analytics only to the existing Next.js application boundary; third-party capture is performed server-side and must never block product availability.

Only a finite event-name and property allowlist may be transmitted; free text, form values, email, phone, arbitrary URLs, nested objects, tenant data, auth data and protected-route data are discarded.

No registration, authentication, role assignment, tenant isolation, RBAC, database schema, API authority, CSP relaxation, GitHub workflow, release authority or REG.RU topology is changed by this implementation.
PostHog capture must use person-profile suppression and geo-IP enrichment disablement. Visitor network addresses must not be deliberately placed in event properties.
No new npm dependency or recurring paid infrastructure commitment is introduced by this scope.
Existing Yandex public analytics boundary and its session-replay prohibition remain unchanged unless independently governed later.
